title: columnea domingensis
intro: Columnea domingensis, commonly known as the "Dominguez Columnea" or "Purple Columnea", is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Columnea domingensis include its ability to act as an antitussive, helping to relieve coughs, and as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
